name: Extended Marching Cubes
definition: A variant of Marching Cubes that modifies the field function to return three values (distance from contour on each axis) to compute exact intersection coordinates independently, and uses normal vectors with Quadric Error Functions (QEF) to reconstruct sharp features.
summary: Extended Marching Cubes is a surface extraction method that preserves sharp edges and corners by modifying the field function and using Quadric Error Functions to reconstruct features.
